text:
mai: FYI I dropped a compact release notes block + localized copy placeholders for EMEA. Need SDK snippet parity (Py/JS), a short migration note, and to flag any known issues before we push. PTAL :eyes:
oliver: Link?
mai: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/relnotes/draft-3498-localize  Key items: embeddings API rename to `embeddings.create_v2` (Python) / `createV2` (JS); we also found quantization mismatches on older GPUs for long contexts — should be in Known issues.
rachel: I'll update the Python snippet and the localized hero blurb. Proposed inline Py: `resp = client.embeddings.create_v2(model=\"rwd-embed-1\", input=[\"ciao\"])` 
tim: I'll handle the JS snippet and a short migration note that points to the SDK guide. JS inline: `const resp = await client.embeddings.createV2({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: ['ciao'] });` Keep inline examples tiny.
mai: Good. Also need a one-liner for Dedicated customers under Platform changes about an SLO adjustment for low-latency small-batch traffic; hide behind enterprise CTA.
oliver: Quick heads-up: the routing docs had a bad anchor for rollout-policy again. I bookmarked it in the PR comments.
devex-bot: CI for PR #8475: linkcheck failed (rollout-policy anchor missing), lint passed. https://ci.internal/builds/8475
rachel: I'll patch anchor and run the link-checker locally, will also add the Known issues paragraph referring to bug RED-2146.
tim: For the migration note I suggest calling out casing differences explicitly: "Python: create_v2() vs JS: createV2()" and a one-line example of migrating an existing call.
mai: Good call. Also add a troubleshooting tip under Known issues: "If you observe token-level drift after quantized deployment, re-run a small subset of evals in full precision to verify impact." Short and actionable.
oliver: After fixes I'll run staging preview and a snippet render pass. If staging is green we can merge and schedule publish next Mon 09:00 CET (EMEA-friendly) / Tue 01:00 PT.
rachel: Pushed commit: updated snippets, fixed rollout-policy anchor, added Known issues + troubleshooting tip. Commit e9f3b1. Ran local linkcheck: clean.
devex-bot: CI updated: linkcheck passed, staging build queued. https://ci.internal/builds/8475
tim: Previewed on staging: inline snippets render, migration link resolves, localized placeholder text present. Minor nit: JS snippet whitespace can be tightened. Sending micro-PR.
mai: Thanks. Oliver, can you re-run the staging linkcheck & visual QA after Tim's tiny change?
oliver: Will do. If all green I'll approve for merge.
mai: Plan to ship Monday morning for EMEA rollouts. Thanks team :tada:
